description: Mechanisms aligned to the nine Personal Wellness Blueprint body systems

mechanisms.name: Beneficial Gut Bacteria
mechanisms.description: Supports the growth, diversity and metabolic activity of beneficial gut microorganisms that contribute to digestive function, immune regulation, nutrient metabolism and overall host health.
mechanisms.plainEnglish: Helps nourish the beneficial bacteria in your gut, supporting digestion, immunity and overall wellbeing.

mechanisms.name: Short-Chain Fatty Acid Production
mechanisms.description: Enhances microbial production of short-chain fatty acids including acetate, propionate and butyrate, supporting intestinal integrity, immune regulation and metabolic health.
mechanisms.plainEnglish: Helps your gut bacteria produce beneficial compounds that nourish the bowel and support overall health.

mechanisms.name: Gut Barrier Integrity
mechanisms.description: Maintains the integrity of the intestinal epithelial barrier by supporting tight junction function and regulating intestinal permeability.
mechanisms.plainEnglish: Helps keep the gut lining strong so unwanted substances are less likely to pass into the bloodstream.

mechanisms.name: Digestive Enzyme Activity
mechanisms.description: Supports the production and activity of digestive enzymes involved in the efficient digestion of proteins, fats and carbohydrates.
mechanisms.plainEnglish: Helps your body break down food efficiently so nutrients can be absorbed properly.

mechanisms.name: Microbiome Diversity
mechanisms.description: Promotes a diverse and resilient gut microbial ecosystem associated with improved digestive, metabolic and immune function.
mechanisms.plainEnglish: Helps maintain a healthy variety of beneficial gut bacteria.

mechanisms.name: Nutrient Absorption
mechanisms.description: Supports the efficient absorption and utilisation of vitamins, minerals, amino acids, fatty acids and other nutrients across the intestinal lining.
mechanisms.plainEnglish: Helps your body absorb nutrients from the food you eat.

mechanisms.name: Mucosal Health
mechanisms.description: Supports the health and maintenance of the gastrointestinal mucosal lining, contributing to protection, repair and normal digestive function.
mechanisms.plainEnglish: Helps maintain the protective lining of the digestive tract.

mechanisms.name: Gastrointestinal Motility
mechanisms.description: Supports coordinated movement of the gastrointestinal tract, promoting healthy transit time and digestive function.
mechanisms.plainEnglish: Helps food move through the digestive system at a healthy rate.

mechanisms.name: Intestinal Inflammation
mechanisms.description: Modulates inflammatory signalling within the intestinal environment, supporting tissue integrity and digestive homeostasis.
mechanisms.plainEnglish: Helps maintain a healthy inflammatory balance within the gut.

mechanisms.name: Intestinal Epithelial Repair
mechanisms.description: Supports the repair and regeneration of intestinal epithelial cells following normal physiological stress or injury.
mechanisms.plainEnglish: Helps the cells lining the intestine repair and renew themselves.

mechanisms.name: Mucin Production
mechanisms.description: Supports the production and maintenance of the protective mucus layer lining the gastrointestinal tract.
mechanisms.plainEnglish: Helps maintain the protective mucus layer that shields the gut lining.

mechanisms.name: Bile Acid Metabolism
mechanisms.description: Supports healthy bile acid metabolism and recycling, contributing to lipid digestion, microbial balance and metabolic regulation.
mechanisms.plainEnglish: Helps your body recycle bile acids so fats can be digested efficiently.
